data: What is the percentage of captions asked for in round 1?

The question asks for the percentage of captions asked for in round 1. From the caption, we can see that the blue line represents the "Percent task collect" and the red line represents the "Average collect reward." The y-axis on the left side of the graph shows the "Percent task collect," which corresponds to the percentage of captions asked for. By examining the graph, we can see that the blue line starts at approximately 56% in round 1. Therefore, the percentage of captions asked for in round 1 is around 56%.
